text.description_html:
First Impressions 3671/24 24 Inch "S" Shape Door Pull

This all new "S" pull flows effortlessly made of long lasting stainless steel. Nice sized 1" diameter pull handle is easy to grab. Perfect for office entry doors, commercial store front doors, appliance doors, just about anywhere a sleek door pull is needed.

Specifications for First Impressions First Impressions 3671/24 "S" Door Pull

  • Total Length: 24"
  • Pull Handle Diameter: 1"
  • Mounting Bracket Diameter: 1-1/2"
  • Projection: 3"
  • Material: Stainless Steel Tubing
  • Polished Stainless Steel Finish

Note: This beautiful door pull is handmade in the USA when you order it—allowing it to be custom designed to fit your specific door application, including Other Lengths up to 5 feet. Unfortunately, because of the made-to-order nature of the door handle, it is Not Returnable. Please Contact Us with your requirements or if you have any questions.

Packaged Standard with Thrubolt mounting (Bolts thru the door). Optional Surface mounting or Back to Back mounting available (Pulls bolt to each other - Requires 2 door pulls).

*Sold individually.
